title: Candidate V/Y composition
result: V² RMSE1.031 versus identity; V²Y.979 versus identity1.007; additive rival remained.
lesson: No compact reusable operation was established.

title: Query bank rank
result: Effective rank8.895; top16 reconstructed scores RMSE.009 and94.4% of changes.
lesson: Ordinary readout geometry is a strong competing explanation.

title: Query rank at initialization
result: Initial effective rank1.5–1.8; training expanded it.
lesson: Low rank alone is not evidence of acquired computational structure.

title: K identity-edit patching
result: Changed-token patch after block0 restored.96–1 final contrast; attention ablation hurt, MLP not.
lesson: The tested identity signal has a causal attention route in this synthetic model.

title: Global token transport
result: Global mean transport score RMSE.045–.062, but nearest-neighbor15–38% better.
lesson: Successful approximate transport did not defeat a simple memory/interpolation rival.

title: Identity attention decomposition
result: Fixed-weight value changes explained99–101%; weight term around−1to1%.
lesson: This edit did not support a dynamic attention-routing account.

title: Identity×event joint patches
result: Joint patches looked predictable, but full-tensor additivity was as good or better.
lesson: The apparent composition did not require a special operator law.

title: Initialization relay control
result: Initial identity information existed but the localized relay was weak.
lesson: Local information and a learned functional pathway are distinguishable here.

title: K/L relay development
result: Across36 checkpoints K relay grew, L varied.
lesson: A descriptive developmental correlate was not an independently validated predictor.

title: Fresh identity pair relay
result: A showed strong relay for observed pairs and weak held-out; K recruited an existing route.
lesson: No evidence that K invented a distinct operator.

title: Renderer source-only audit
result: A source-only event heuristic solved9,000 canonical scenes perfectly.
lesson: Canonical success was not evidence of using both objects.

title: Target-swap interventions
result: Ordinary target swaps flipped event about4.7%; mirror swaps100% but out of distribution.
lesson: A strong shortcut existed, yet strict target independence was not established.

title: Geometry-only target recombinations
result: 96 marginally in-range recombinations flipped events43–50% in A,18–49% in K.
lesson: Strict source-only computation was falsified; joint-support distribution shift remains.

title: Target value-to-source-to-CLS
result: Fixed-weight value hybrids caused15–52% flips, weights at most about1%.
lesson: A target influence route existed; this did not establish an abstract relation operator.

title: Train balanced world seed3701
result: Familiar task accuracy.9992.
lesson: The revised renderer could be learned without the canonical source-only shortcut.

title: Balanced-world source-matched contrasts
result: Opposite-event pairs with exact matched source flipped99%; target/source routes distributed.
lesson: Behavior depended on the relation under the revised experience.

title: Balanced world seed3702
result: Five predeclared criteria passed; task.9996; target-patch.913 versus first seed.415.
lesson: Behavior replicated while internal implementation strength varied substantially.

title: Balanced-world exact attention terms
result: Weight, value and residual interactions were substantial and nonlinear.
lesson: Signed decomposition fractions are not independent causal shares.

title: Old-model geometry edits
result: Old models also had weight terms.40–.59 for geometry edits.
lesson: The supposed old-value/new-routing difference partly reflected which edit was applied.

title: Event-preserving geometry control
result: Nuisance edits also changed attention routing, TV.126–.182.
lesson: Routing changes were not specific evidence of semantic event construction; magnitude matching imperfect.

title: Cue versus relation training
result: Two seeds/condition, task about.9975–1; conflict NO_CUE followed relation.982/.989, CUE followed cue.998/1.
lesson: Controlled experience causally selected the variable driving behavior.

title: Cue/relation pathway audit
result: Candidate geometry tracked the usable variable; query alone insufficient; paths varied by seed.
lesson: Experience effects were not explained by one universal query-only route.

title: P95 versus P99 cue reliability
result: All familiar task about.99; relation preference P95.693/.672, P99.151/.028.
lesson: Rare contradictions changed acquisition markedly, with seed variation; not a count law.

title: Extend P99 to8k
result: Relation preference.363/.047 remained variable.
lesson: More training did not guarantee the desired relational policy.

title: CUE↔P95 switch
result: One-thousand-update switches from exact parent models acquired/lost relational preference.
lesson: Current experience can change which information controls answers.

title: Cross-model query/candidate recombination
result: Raw cross-model recombination failed and cosine was low.
lesson: Coordinate mismatch and coadaptation can hide behavioral correspondence.

title: 48×48 Procrustes
result: Held-identity query cosine.797/.738 and recipient behavior recovered.
lesson: A learned gauge map can restore correspondence, but high-capacity alignment is an alternative explanation.

title: Gauge fit complexity
result: Eight matched pairs could suffice in the tested low-rank spaces.
lesson: Few examples do not make a high-parameter map a discovered native operator.

title: Shuffled/wrong-event maps
result: Null correspondences were worse.
lesson: Alignment used meaningful matching, though it still did not identify a native operation.

title: Source+target factorization
result: Held query cosine.962–.990 under additive identity factors.
lesson: Simple factorization described representations well.

title: Factorization through development
result: The same description already fit initialization at cosine.994/.993.
lesson: The factorization was not evidence of acquired grammar.

title: Cold-start branch freezing
result: All fixed-branch arms failed task gates, accuracy.388–.677.
lesson: No clean necessity conclusion from an incompetent model.

title: Learned-start branch surgery
result: CUE→P95 candidate-plastic/query-frozen relation.678/.598 with task about.99; opposite plasticity.004/.006 with task about.95.
lesson: Candidate adaptation sufficed for the policy change in these starting models; not a unique circuit claim.

title: Linear candidate event readout
result: Held-identity CUE.55–.60 versus P95.86–.89.
lesson: Experience changed accessibility to a fixed decoder class; low score does not prove absence.

title: RBF candidate event readout
lesson: A stronger tested decoder did not erase the difference; unlimited decodability remains untested.

title: DeepSets candidate control
result: Candidate encoder without attention reproduced CUE/P95 pattern; NO_CUE missed.95 gate.
lesson: Candidate attention was not necessary for the bounded pattern; query remained a Transformer.

title: First affine composition world
result: An exact additive shortcut invalidated the proposed R→T world after an initial audit pass.
lesson: A rejected dataset is not a learning failure; the shortcut was caught before training.

title: Redesigned noncommuting world
result: T→R world passed the listed easy-shortcut audits.
lesson: Only those audited alternatives were excluded; no empirical result at this stage.

title: Transformer/MLP composition
result: Two Transformers and two MLPs fit seen R² about.999; all failed held T→R, Transformer about.21, MLP negative.
lesson: Seen-fit competence did not imply compositional extension.

title: Transformer failure signature
result: Held predictions nearly matched wrong-order additive Rx+v, MSE.001.
lesson: A simple output extension explained failure without proving the network's circuit.

title: One-axis bridge dataset
result: Constructed a bridge exposing a subset of composition directions.
lesson: A bridge can separate exposure and extrapolation; no model result yet.

title: One-axis bridge transfer
result: Both architectures learned bridge but failed orthogonal transfer; MLP commutator cosine overstated success.
lesson: Directional similarity is not functional compositional correctness.

title: Shared transition MLP
result: Explicit parameter reuse reached R²>.999 without held T→R training.
lesson: The world supports transfer under a supplied inductive bias, not demonstrated learned Transformer operators.

title: Rank1 versus rank2 bridges
result: Designed matched-exposure bridge spans.
lesson: Span coverage could be tested separately from gross example count.

title: Train rank-matched bridge worlds
result: Rank2 all four models held-y R².984–.996; rank1 weaker.
lesson: Exposing independent directions improved extension in this artificial world.

title: Bilinear null model
result: Tiny bilinear regression also reached rank2 R²1.
lesson: The behavior did not require an internal reusable operator; closed this world family as mechanism evidence.
